scope: Fresh authenticated notification open authorization over native and GraphQL storefront transports

policy.owner_scope: Tenant and recipient are derived from authenticated request context and revalidated by NotificationInboxStorefrontPort
policy.principal_boundary: Missing authentication and OAuth service principals receive the same stable user-required envelope
policy.tenant_boundary: Authentication and tenant context must match before module or identifier validation
policy.module_boundary: The Notifications module must be enabled before notification identifier validation and owner access
policy.request_boundary: The GraphQL query accepts only one bounded notification UUID and no tenant recipient or user identity
policy.identifier_boundary: The notification id is non-empty control-free at most 64 bytes parseable as a non-nil UUID
policy.port_boundary: GraphQL open authorization carries canonical user actor claims locale storefront channel correlation id and a five-second deadline
policy.ownership_boundary: The owner query filters notification identity by tenant and recipient before current policy and source authorization
policy.authorization_boundary: Current recipient policy and current source target-open authorization are evaluated for every open request
policy.non_oracular_boundary: Missing foreign suppressed and no-longer-openable notifications all return UNAVAILABLE
policy.route_boundary: Only ALLOWED carries the bounded owner NotificationTargetRoute and the storefront rejects ALLOWED without a route
policy.transport_boundary: SSR and hydrate select native authorization while CSR and headless select GraphQL with no fallback
policy.compatibility_boundary: The existing UI-facing open function delegates to the selected facade and raw native authorization remains explicitly named
policy.error_boundary: Unsafe owner and port failures collapse to a generic stable unavailable GraphQL envelope
policy.write_boundary: Group-state commands remain native-only and retain write deadline plus idempotency admission

not_delivered: auth-reactive automatic grouped inbox bootstrap refresh without an explicit resource refresh
